name: New retail: RTX 5090 32GB and current-generation consumer cards (Amazon.com list)
price_basis: NEW-RETAIL list prices, sealed retail cards, USD, observed 2026-10-03, single channel (amazon.com via a price-table aggregator). Excludes tax/shipping as quoted by Amazon.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-gpuquicklist-amazon. THIS IS THE ONLY GENUINE NEW-RETAIL BAND IN THE SLICE, and it is a single-channel list price, not a market index - state that whenever this record is cited. BAND: RTX 5090 32GB n=2 at $6,549.99 and $6,749.99. n=2 is the entire sample and it is below this repo's bar for treating a median as meaningful, so read the pair, not the midpoint. Supporting bands from the same table (recorded, not used for price_usd): RTX 5080 n=10, $1,549.99-$1,803.63; RTX 5070 Ti n=0 on this table; RTX 5070 n=1 $856.99. CROSS-CHECK, kept as a contested pair rather than resolved: the secondary-market ASKING band for the RTX 5090 (sup-price-new-retail-rtx-4090-3090-consumer sibling and the PicClick 5090 pull) centred ~$6,500 over n=47, which matches this new-retail list to within rounding. For the 5090 the new-retail and secondary-asking markets are the same price; that is NOT true of the 4090 or 3090, where secondary asks run at or above new list. Note the aggregator also carries two Renewed rows (RTX 3080 $579.99, RTX 3090 $1,899.99) - refurbished, explicitly NOT used-market, and the 3090 renewed figure sits ABOVE the used 3090 asking median of $1,514, which is a concrete instance of a renewed unit outbidding a used one.
